about: What changed on nfs2se.xyz, day by day. Kinds: new, improved, fixed. Days run 05:00 to 05:00 Polish time. nfs3-webgl's tools/discord/changelog.mjs posts them to Discord.

items: fixed

Lap Records: the name a new player gets (Racer and 3 digits) was nearly always another player's by now, so their laps weren't taken. New players get a free name, and a given name that's someone else's changes to a free one by itself. Pick your own under Your name any time.
fixed
Online: after the first race of a knockout everyone waited at "waiting for players", sometimes for good. A pause of more than a few seconds in an online race didn't end either. Both carry on now.
fixed

Lap Records: the game turned catch-up on by itself in every online race, so whoever fell behind went faster than anyone can alone. Those laps, old ones too, are now under the new Catch-up & mods tab, tagged CU.
improved
Catch-up starts off (Game Setup turns it on; online, the host decides). Online races without it count for the Standard boards.
new
Laps driven with mods on count too, on the Catch-up & mods boards, tagged MOD.
fixed
Lap Records: watching a replay in the game (View Replay) counted its laps as yours. Replays don't count now.
fixed
Lap Records: races driven alone while waiting in an online room count now, with Instant steering.
improved
Lap Records: a race's replay that didn't go up when it ended goes up the next time you open the page.
fixed
Online: two races in one room pulled each other's cars around. Each race only listens to its own now.
new
Online rooms show each player's country flag.
new
With the game open in another tab, Play here instead moves it here. A tab where it's running keeps it until Exit Game.
improved
Phones: the download keeps the screen on and carries on after the screen locks. On mobile data (Android) it asks first.
improved
Instagram's and Facebook's own browsers now show how to open the page in Chrome or Safari. Private windows and full disks are told before the download.
fixed
http://nfs2se.xyz links now go to the secure page, where the game can run.
fixed
Windows: on some sound devices the sound broke up every few seconds.
improved
Fewer short freezes while the game loads, and Start is quicker from the second time on.
improved
When the game stops on a missing or damaged file, the page downloads it again and says so, or that the storage is full.
new

Your name is yours: change it whenever you like and your lap records go with it. The Lap Records and Most Active Racers show each racer once, with their best. Records from before stay with the name they were driven under, and go to whoever comes back with that name saved.
new

Race as yourself on another device: Use on another device, under Your name, shows 8 words. Enter them on your phone or another computer to race there with your name and lap records. No account, no e-mail.
new

Lap Records: ▶ replay on a best lap is the game's own replay of the race it was driven in. Click it and it's in your game under Options › Load/Save › View Replay. Nothing to do for your own: after each race, the replay goes with your laps by itself.
fixed
Replays and tournaments you save in the game now show up under Options › Load/Save. Before, the lists never found them.
fixed
Lap Records: if you drive your best time twice, the board now shows the lap that has a replay. Before, it could keep the earlier lap and hide the ▶ replay.
new
Phones: steer with a thumb stick or by tilting the phone, gently or hard; new buttons for camera, look behind, horn and gears; touch settings in Game Settings.
improved
Online: a joining player's game no longer stutters when the host's updates arrive late, other cars slide into place instead of jumping, and a dropped connection gets its place in the room back.
fixed
iPhone: touch buttons no longer stick or select text; sound plays with the silent switch on and comes back after a call.
fixed
Races on slow computers and Chromebooks no longer slow to a crawl: the game's sound mixing was starving the rest of the game.
improved
Smoother on slow computers and Chromebooks: drawing a frame takes about a tenth of the browser work it did, leaving more of the CPU to the game.
new
Discord server for help, bug reports, ideas and finding races: linked in the menu and in the early-version note.
new
What's New: this list of changes, day by day.
new
Lap Records on the start page: every racer's best lap on each track, in both directions. Laps driven with mods on don't count.
new
Instant steering (Game Settings): the wheels turn to full lock at once, like with a joystick back in the day.
new
Phones and tablets: on-screen buttons to steer, brake and accelerate; a finger on the picture works as the mouse.
new
iPhone: the game files now save on iOS 18, and the page shows how to get fullscreen with Add to Home Screen.
new
Bonus cars (Bomber BFS, Tombstone, FZR 2000) and the Monolithic Studios track unlocked (Game Settings, on by default).
fixed
The picture was too dark, night tracks nearly black: the game's own brightness setting and fog are now used.
fixed
Cars driving into a shadow lost their textures in black speckles.
improved
On 60, 120 and 240 Hz screens every frame is shown once: no more small hitches.
improved
Sharpness starts at Auto; the Resolutions option, which did nothing in this game, is gone.
fixed
Long sessions no longer run out of memory.
new
First version: Need for Speed II: Special Edition (the 3dfx version) recompiled to WebAssembly. The game files download automatically, once.
new
A start page in the style of the game's menus.
new
Online races: lobby, rooms and invite links; the game's network screens draw correctly, and your car reacts at once even when someone else hosts.
new
Your lobby name is your name in the game (up to 8 characters).
fixed
Cars flashed other cars' colours; each car now keeps its own.
